Turn month-end billing exceptions into an approval-ready close

Help finance and billing teams find blocked work, enforce time-entry rules, prepare support for eligible invoices, and resolve disputed-hour evidence without posting revenue or contacting a client.

**Why try it:** The demo shows exactly why work is blocked and separates invoice-ready support from entries that still need narrative, approval, or milestone evidence.

## Problem Statement

Professional services billing combines large time volumes, contract-specific rules, budget pressure, premium work, and client disputes. Manual review makes it easy to miss evidence, overstate invoice readiness, or treat fixed-fee time like time-and-materials billing.

## Solution Summary

Microsoft Copilot Studio is the finance-facing entry point. Dynamics 365 provides project and billing context, SharePoint holds approval evidence, and Microsoft Teams supports governed exception review.

**Blueprint role:** Creates an approval-gated billing control point between time capture, invoice support, and client-facing finance work.

**Capabilities:** Billing blocker review; Close rollup; Time-entry control checks; Approval-gated invoice support; Disputed-hours evidence brief. See [responsibilities and trust boundaries](2.Architecture.md).

- Improves visibility into billing blockers and leakage.
- Strengthens invoice support and audit consistency.
- Gives finance teams a safer path for resolving disputed hours.

Claims are qualitative; synthetic demo figures are not customer results or performance commitments. See the [claims policy](../../solutions/README.md#claims-policy).

## In Scope / Out of Scope

### In scope

- List unapproved billable entries, their value and evidence gaps, and show outstanding invoices separately.
- Summarize hours, project budgets and consultant activity by project and by consultant, labeled not posted revenue.
- Flag narrative, daily-hours, rate, approval and budget issues using only the packaged rules.
- Group only approved billable T&M entries as invoice support and hold fixed-fee work until milestone evidence determines value.
- Brief each dispute's client concern, evidence present and missing, and the recommended internal approval path.

### Out of scope / approval boundary

- No creating, altering, classifying, approving, rejecting or deleting time entries, and no invented work descriptions.
- No revenue recognition, accounting posting, invoice generation or sending, charge waiver or invoice-status change.
- No client contact, and no dispute represented as resolved.
- No browsing or finance-system queries; the frozen synthetic close snapshot is the only source.
- No SharePoint upload, Teams message or approval action; both remain production seams.
- No workshop publishing: publishing remains separately authorized.

## Qualification Checklist

- [ ] Is a Microsoft Copilot Studio target environment, with an approved publisher prefix, available for the billing build?
- [ ] Can the delivery team use the Copilot Studio plugin with PAC CLI 2.9.3 or newer and initialize a `cli-copilot` project?
- [ ] Has the customer mapped project and billing context to Dynamics 365 and approval evidence to SharePoint?
- [ ] Will Microsoft Teams carry governed exception review, and who acts on each exception?
- [ ] Are consultant, project-manager, billing-manager, milestone and finance approvers named for every gate the rules require?
- [ ] Are milestone schedules available for fixed-fee contracts before any fixed-fee invoice support is prepared?
- [ ] Is publication held for separate authorization after TEB-01 through TEB-05 replay on the reviewed Draft?
- [ ] Have replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures been agreed for production billing review?

## What Actually Goes Wrong

- **unapproved-work-invoiced:** Unapproved or undescribed work lands in invoice support.
- **fixed-fee-billed-as-tm:** Fixed-fee time is converted into an invoice amount like time-and-materials work.
- **rollup-read-as-revenue:** A billing rollup is presented as posted or recognized revenue.
- **fabricated-narrative:** A missing work description is written by the agent to make an entry billable.
- **template-control-thresholds:** Customer time is audited with the template's daily-hours limit, rate checks and budget bands.
- **anchors-without-grounding:** The grounding files fail to load and the agent rebuilds answers from the locked evidence anchors.

See [state and recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery).
